description: This file contains bundled JavaScript modules related to the Isotope layout library, including utilities, event emitters, size measurement, and item layout classes, with a focus on enabling grid and layout functionalities in web projects.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Represents an individual item in the layout, handling size, position, CSS styling, and transition effects.

classes.name: LayoutMode
classes.description: Base class for different layout modes such as Masonry, managing size measurements and layout logic.

classes.name: Masonry
classes.description: A layout class extending Outlayer, implementing cascading grid layout with column measurement and positioning.

methods.name: jQueryBridget
methods.description: Creates a jQuery plugin from a JavaScript class, enabling method calls and options setting via jQuery syntax.

methods.name: EvEmitter
methods.description: A lightweight event emitter class supporting on, once, off, and emitEvent methods for event handling.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Utility function to measure the size and position of DOM elements, accounting for styles and box-sizing.

methods.name: Item.prototype._create
methods.description: Initializes transition properties and sets the element's position to absolute.

methods.name: Item.prototype.getSize
methods.description: Calculates and stores the size of the item element.

methods.name: Item.prototype.css
methods.description: Applies CSS styles to the item element, using vendor prefixes where necessary.

methods.name: Item.prototype.getPosition
methods.description: Determines the current position of the element based on computed styles.

methods.name: Item.prototype.layoutPosition
methods.description: Sets the element's position based on internal x and y coordinates, applying padding and layout options.

methods.name: Item.prototype._transitionTo
methods.description: Transitions the item to a new x,y position with CSS transforms and transition effects.

methods.name: Item.prototype.getTranslate
methods.description: Generates a CSS translate3d string for moving the element.

methods.name: Item.prototype.goTo
methods.description: Moves the item instantly to specified x,y coordinates.

methods.name: Item.prototype.moveTo
methods.description: Alias for _transitionTo, moves the item with transition effects.

methods.name: Item.prototype.setPosition
methods.description: Sets internal x and y position values.

methods.name: Item.prototype.transition
methods.description: Performs a CSS transition to new styles, handling transition end events and callbacks.

methods.name: Item.prototype.ontransitionend
methods.description: Handles the end of CSS transitions, cleaning up styles and triggering callbacks.

methods.name: Item.prototype.disableTransition
methods.description: Disables CSS transitions and removes transition event listeners.

methods.name: LayoutMode
methods.description: Base class for layout modes such as Masonry, managing size measurements and layout logic.

methods.name: Masonry
methods.description: A layout class extending Outlayer, implementing cascading grid layout with column measurement and positioning.
